prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE N5 school vocabulary stimulus. ONE square image, one scene, pure white seamless background, only the named referents and indispensable support, no bystanders or unrelated objects. Entire composition centered in central 70 percent with broad white margin ALL sides; whole figures and objects, correct natural anatomy, friendly and suitable for primary school. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, symbols, watermark or collage. Make the exact spatial/possession/content relation visually unambiguous. Medium: friendly flat 2D educational drawing, no 3D. Exact target OVELLA + TENIR + CÒMIC. One recognizable friendly sheep sitting calmly and holding a closed comic book with both front hooves. Comic cover shows a small grid of two or three colorful simple wordless cartoon panels, no speech balloons, letters, words, numbers, logo or writing anywhere. Visible thin page block distinguishes book, sheep has woolly body, sheep muzzle, ears, four limbs and short tail, no extra arms. Static possession, not reading. Entire sheep and comic, broad margins.
review: Ovella amb còmic tancat entre les peülles; vinyetes de coberta sense text, cos i quatre extremitats clars.
